alibabacloud-cleversee-search 0.0.1-beta.1 — Initial Beta Release

- Provides AI-powered web search via the cleversee CLI for Alibaba Cloud users, offering high-quality, low-latency internet retrieval with advanced filtering.
- Implements secure authentication reusing Aliyun CLI profiles; supports OAuth and RamRoleArn modes.
- Requires explicit user confirmation for all customizable parameters before command execution.
- Enforces RAM permissions (`AliyunCleverSeeAISearchPlatformUserAccess`) with guided permission error handling.
- Includes detailed setup, authentication, parameter configuration, usage workflow, and best practices.
- No resources are created by search; no cleanup required.
